info.name: TireMax API
info.description:
Full REST API collection for the TireMax tire e-commerce platform. Covers authentication, product catalog, cart management, orders, bookings, favorites, and reviews.

**Setup:**
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server (e.g. `http://localhost:8000/api`).
2. Call **Login** or **Register** and copy the `access_token` into the `authToken` variable.
3. All authenticated endpoints automatically send `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`.

variable.description: Base URL of the API server (no trailing slash)
JWT Bearer token received from /auth/login or /auth/register

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token refresh, profile management, and logout.

request.description:
Create a new customer account. Returns a JWT token pair on success.

**Body fields:**
- `name` *(required, string, max 120)* — Customer full name
- `phone` *(required, string, max 20, unique)* — Mobile phone number used as login identifier
- `email` *(optional, email, max 120, unique)* — Email address
- `password` *(required, string, min 6)* — Account password
- `password_confirmation` *(required)* — Must match `password`
- `address` *(optional, string, max 255)* — Default shipping address
- `locale` *(optional, enum: en|ar)* — Preferred language for API messages

response.name: 422 Validation Error

request.description:
Authenticate an existing customer. The `login` field accepts either a phone number or email address.

**Body fields:**
- `login` *(required, string)* — Customer phone number or email address
- `password` *(required, string)* — Account password

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Exchange an expiring JWT token for a fresh one. Send the current token in the `Authorization` header; receive a new token in the response.

**No request body required.**

Returns the authenticated customer's profile data.

**No parameters required.** Authentication via `Authorization: Bearer` header.

Update the authenticated customer's profile. All fields are optional — only send the fields you want to change.

**Body fields (all optional):**
- `name` *(string, max 120)* — Customer display name
- `email` *(email, max 120, unique)* — Email address (must not belong to another account)
- `address` *(string, max 255)* — Default delivery address
- `locale` *(enum: en|ar)* — Preferred language
- `password` *(string, min 6)* — New password
- `password_confirmation` *(string)* — Required when `password` is provided

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Invalidate the current JWT token. After calling this endpoint the token can no longer be used.

**No request body required.**

item.name: Home
item.description: Homepage data aggregating featured products, best sellers, new arrivals, sale items, brands, and governorates in a single call.

request.description:
Returns aggregated homepage data in one request:
- `featured` — Up to 12 featured products
- `best_sellers` — Up to 8 best-seller products
- `new_arrivals` — Up to 8 newest products
- `offers` — Up to 8 products on sale
- `brands` — All active brands
- `governorates` — All active governorates

**No parameters required. Auth optional.**

item.name: Flash Sales
item.description: Flash sales are time-limited discount events. All flash-sale endpoints are public (no authentication required). Products returned include a computed `flash_sale_price` and `countdown_seconds` field so the client can display a live countdown timer.

request.description:
Returns all **currently running** flash sales ordered by soonest ending first.

A flash sale is considered active when:
- `is_active = true`
- `starts_at <= now()`
- `ends_at >= now()`

Use the `countdown_seconds` field to drive a client-side countdown timer.

response.name: 200 OK — active sales exist

query.description: Filter products by type. Allowed values: `tire` | `battery` | `accessory`. Omit to return all types.
Number of products to return per page. Default: `15`. Max recommended: `50`.

request.description:
Returns a **paginated list of products** belonging to the specified flash sale.

Only **active** products are returned. Each product includes:
- `flash_sale_price` — the discounted price after applying `discount_percent`
- `flash_sale_discount_percent` — the sale's discount percentage
- `countdown_seconds` — seconds remaining until the sale ends

**Path parameter:**
- `{flashSale}` *(required, integer)* — The flash sale ID from `GET /v1/flash-sales`

Returns `404` if the flash sale ID does not exist.
